a11y.title: Accessibility statement
a11y.intro: We want every student, coordinator and interviewer to use the system without difficulty, on any device.

did.standard: Built to WCAG 2.1 level AA guidelines
did.keyboard: All forms and navigation work with the keyboard alone
did.screenReader: Every field has a label, every button a name, and errors are announced to screen readers
did.contrast: Sufficient color contrast, and information is never conveyed by color alone
did.mobile: Mobile friendly, with no horizontal scrolling and large tap targets
did.rtl: Hebrew right-to-left by default, English left-to-right

a11y.limits: We tested with automated tools and partial manual testing, not with every screen reader. Dashboard charts come with a table holding the same information. The hours certificate is produced for printing or saving as PDF through the browser.
a11y.contact: If something isn't accessible, write to us and we'll fix it.
